name: WNBA_R1A4C_FULL_PREFIX_CONSTRUCTOR_CUSTODY_V1
purpose: Construct and freeze point-in-time WNBA historical prefix feature rows from pinned static sources. Each target row must be sealed before any score/stat value from that target date is read. Raw completed-game values may enter only the prefix of later dates.

source_custody.download_rule: Every source asset is addressed by frozen GitHub release asset_id and must match frozen byte size and SHA-256 before use.

two_phase_daily_chokepoint.phase_1: For target date D, construct and serialize every eligible regular-season target row using only the in-memory prefix from dates strictly earlier than D.
two_phase_daily_chokepoint.phase_2: Only after every target row for D is sealed may the constructor project score/stat columns for game_ids on D and append those completed-game records to the prefix for dates after D.
two_phase_daily_chokepoint.same_day_prior_games: Never used. Even if one game on date D actually ended before another game on D tipped, no date-D box value may enter another date-D target row because final timestamps are not certified in the static source.
two_phase_daily_chokepoint.future_games: Never projected into memory before their date becomes the phase-2 ingest date.
two_phase_daily_chokepoint.target_game: Never present in its own prefix.

frozen_fallback_formula.quantization: pace/offRtg/defRtg/netRtg/ppg/recentPpg/SOS outputs round to one decimal; winRate/recentWinPct round to two decimals

frozen_recent_semantics.recentPpg: mean points scored over latest up to 10 prior finalized games
frozen_recent_semantics.recentWinPct: wins/latest up to 10 prior finalized games

frozen_schedule_context_semantics.gamesPlayed: count of prior finalized regular-season games in prefix
frozen_schedule_context_semantics.daysRest: integer calendar-day difference between target date and latest prior-game date
frozen_schedule_context_semantics.isB2B: preserve deployed quirk: true when calendar-day gap between latest and second-latest prior games is <=1 day; it is NOT target-vs-last-game B2B
frozen_schedule_context_semantics.b2bWasRoad: true only when isB2B is true and the second-latest prior game was road
frozen_schedule_context_semantics.gamesLast7: prior games with game date >= target date minus 7 calendar days
frozen_schedule_context_semantics.streak: signed consecutive W/L run beginning with latest prior final; wins positive and losses negative

frozen_sos_semantics.opponent_occurrences: Use the target team's latest up to 10 prior opponents in game order; repeated opponents remain repeated and therefore retain deployed occurrence weighting.
frozen_sos_semantics.opponent_season_stats: For each opponent occurrence, calculate fallback offRtg/defRtg from that opponent's full prefix strictly before target date.
frozen_sos_semantics.opponent_recent_stats: For each opponent occurrence, calculate fallback offRtg/defRtg from that opponent's latest up to 10 prefix games strictly before target date.
frozen_sos_semantics.blend: If recent stats exist, blendedOff=0.4*seasonOff+0.6*recentOff and blendedDef=0.4*seasonDef+0.6*recentDef; otherwise use season stats.
frozen_sos_semantics.output: Average blended off and def over usable opponent occurrences; oppAvgNetRtg=avgOff-avgDef. Round outputs to one decimal.
frozen_sos_semantics.missingness: If no opponent occurrence has usable prefix stats, mark SOS_UNAVAILABLE; do not use season-end/future values.

explicitly_not_resolved_by_r1a4c.travelMiles: PENDING_SEASON_VENUE_CERTIFICATION. Current WNBA_ARENAS cannot be silently projected backward because R1A requires season-correct venue custody.
explicitly_not_resolved_by_r1a4c.manualAdjustment: UNRESOLVED_NO_HISTORICAL_LOG. Do not assume zero while claiming exact product replay.
explicitly_not_resolved_by_r1a4c.preferred_BDL_advanced_replay: ACCESS_NOT_CERTIFIED. This constructor remains the separately certified fallback analogue.

rowset_rules.target_identity_source: Pinned schedule plus certified two-sided team_box identity join.
rowset_rules.regular_season_filter: A target must be regular season in both certified identity surfaces; unknown season_type is excluded and reported.
rowset_rules.eligible_target: Both target teams require at least one prior regular-season game and usable fallback season state. SOS may be unavailable and is reported separately rather than zero-filled.
rowset_rules.rowset_digest: Canonical JSON Lines sorted by season,target_date,game_id; SHA-256 frozen from exact bytes.
